entities.summary: Democratic Bulgaria was a political alliance in Bulgaria. Founded on 12 April 2018 as an electoral alliance between three political parties – DaB, DSB and the Green Movement, it merged into PP–DB in 2023. In April 2024 the Green Movement left PP–DB. DaB and DSB maintain close relations and brand themselves as "Democratic Bulgaria".
